title: Scheduled task health
pitch: Read every task's last result and next run, then follow each failure from trigger to the action that broke.
makeItYours: Fill the task rows from Get-ScheduledTask piped to Get-ScheduledTaskInfo for LastRunTime, LastTaskResult and NextRunTime.
Translate the result codes you see most often into a cause and a fix for the failure panels.
Point it at several servers and add a Server column before the Task column.
useCase: Use it when a job did not run overnight and you need to know whether the trigger, the task or the action failed.
